Predicates:
Cost(gre, usd205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
Provide(ets, financialAid, x) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or too few resources.
SingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
OutOfWork(x, y) ::: x has been out of work for more than y.
Premises:
Cost(gre, usd205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
∀x (EconomicHardship(x) → Provide(ets, financialAid, x)) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
∀x (EconomicHardship(x) ↔ (TooLittleMoney(x) ∨ TooFewResources(x))) ::: Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or too few resources.
SingleParentFamily(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
OutOfWork(dadTom, year1) ::: His dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Conclusion:
Provide(ets, financialAid, tom) ::: Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
